title: A workshop made of colour
alt: Carved flowers and printing blocks frame an eleven-part Chinese workshop programme.
description: Carved flowers and printing blocks frame an eleven-part Chinese workshop programme.
prompt:
A richly designed Chinese printmaking exhibition poster. Layered woodcut flowers, sculptural ink rollers, intricately carved wooden blocks, colorful printed paper, a small tabletop printing press and delicate leaves form a sophisticated dimensional frame around a clean ivory central space. Coral red, deep green, indigo and warm gold, exquisite visible paper and carved wood textures, precise beautiful shadows, mature contemporary craft design. A large title and three clearly separated paragraphs use crisp Chinese lettering in the clean central space. The surrounding illustration and typography form one integrated finished design.
The complete text on the page reads: “颜色的手艺” “让想象，在纸上留下痕迹” “一场关于版画与手工的展览” “从一条线开始” “认识手中的刻刀，寻找自己的节奏。” “让颜色相遇” “层层叠印之间，看见新的可能。” “把作品带回家” “用一张亲手印的画，记住今天的快乐。” “周末版画工作坊” “河岸工作室 · 欢迎参加”. Render only this quoted copy, with natural line breaks and clear, correct lettering. No extra words.
